claims.claim_ar: الواو في «وَنَجِّنَا...» تعمل واو استئنافية تستأنف الكلام وتربط الطلب (الدعاء) بما سبق من السياق.
claims.claim_en: The initial waw in 'وَنَجِّنَا' functions as a waw of resumption (wa' istinaaf), resuming the discourse and linking the supplicatory petition to the preceding context.
claims.needs_review_reason: The provided chunks are grammatical (i'rab) notes identifying 'الواو استئنافية', but classical balagha sources should be checked to confirm rhetorical intent and effect.
claims.rhetorical_effect: links the supplication to the prior discourse, creating continuity and appeal to what preceded.

claims.claim_ar: يمكن أيضاً تفسير الواو في «وَنَجِّنَا...» على أنها واو عاطفة (عاطفة/عاطف) تربط الطلب بالجملة السابقة بوظيفة ربط/استدراك.
claims.claim_en: Alternatively, the initial waw in 'وَنَجِّنَا' can be read as a coordinating waw (wa' of coordination/retort), connecting the petition to the previous clause as a coordinating or concessive particle.
claims.needs_review_reason: Grammatical commentary in the supplied chunks labels the particle as 'الواو عاطفة' in parallel contexts; a dedicated balagha source should be consulted to prefer this reading over 'استئنافية'.
claims.rhetorical_effect: gives the petition a coordinating/connecting tone, potentially signaling continuation or contrast with what precedes.
